title: Relive 1776: See Boston's History in Augmented Reality (AR)
includes: "Illegal Tea" Souvenir (reusable tea bag with discount card)
Tablets for AR experiences without headsets
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
See Boston's history come back to life in a 5-part immersive tour along The Freedom Trail. Using augmented reality (AR) technology, we tell a chronological series of events from 1765 to 1775 as if they are taking place again at each historical site. Key historical figures and artifacts appear in the real world in front of you as if they've traveled from the past to you.

This is a first-of-its-kind, unforgettable new way to relive history! The experiences are interactive, and use tablets and AR headsets provided by us. For three important historical events, you will wear an AR headset for greater immersiveness and interactivity with hand-tracking technology.

Imagine operating a revolutionary war era field cannon with your own hands! With the Relive 1776 AR Tour, you can.
